# Troubleshooting

Choose the guide that matches the failing stage:

- [Installation](/docs/troubleshooting/installation) for missing prerequisites, plugin loading and marketplace updates
- [Commands](/docs/troubleshooting/commands) for commands that are missing, rejected or running in the wrong context
- [Cloud runs](/docs/troubleshooting/cloud-runs) for GitHub triggers, authorization, secrets and workflow failures

When reporting a problem, include the PRFlow version, operating system, command you ran and the smallest relevant error excerpt. Remove credentials and private repository content first.
